existing.runtime: React 19.1 + Vite 6 + TypeScript 5.8, pnpm with frozen lockfile and release-age policy
existing.styling: Plain CSS with generated design tokens (custom properties); no CSS framework
existing.uiLibrary: Carbon React 1.118 (@carbon/react) and Astro UXDS 8.0 web components
existing.charts: @carbon/charts-react 1.27 (trial chart), d3 7.9, chart.js 3.9 and plotly.js-dist-min 3.1 inside the legacy analysis iframe
existing.content: markdown-it 15 + DOMPurify 3.4 sanitisation, highlight.js 11, diff 9, jszip 3.10
existing.server: Python stdlib HTTP server in shinka/research/ui.py and analysis.py serving the built SPA and the read-only JSON API

notes.ownerDecision20261019: Remove Astro UXDS; keep Carbon React only for interaction and accessibility behaviour; visuals and charts follow the newly selected design system
notes.repositoryBoundary: New files only under shinka/research/, skills/shinka-research/, examples/quant_research/, tests/research/, docs/research/ (AGENTS.md)
notes.network: No runtime network dependencies; all fonts and libraries bundled locally
notes.readOnly: The UI never writes research state
notes.threeDimensionalScatter: The 3D cluster mode projects points onto a Canvas 2D surface with pointer and keyboard rotation and is code-split, so no WebGL engine is added; SVG/D3 remains the chart surface for every 2D figure

capabilities: keyboard-accessible tables, tabs, dialogs, tooltips and menus (behaviour from Carbon React)
token-bound SVG charts with linked selection across views
2D scatter and density contours over embeddings
code-split 3D scatter for embedding clusters, projected on Canvas 2D with pointer and keyboard rotation, and the same points available through the 2D view and an accessible table
syntax-highlighted code and unified diff viewer
sanitised markdown rendering of untrusted LLM output
dark and light themes with CJK-first typography
